title: The System: control, betrayal & Moose’s revenge
summary: The System rises around Moose’s championship ambitions before turning against its own members. Eddie Edwards’ reorganization leaves Moose and JDC seeking revenge against the group they helped establish.

chapters.title: Moose wins at TNA’s new beginning
chapters.result: Moose defeats Alex Shelley for the world championship.
chapters.context: The System’s arrival accompanies Moose’s title victory, positioning the faction as a central force in the restored TNA era.

chapters.title: The System turns on Moose and JDC
chapters.result: Bear Bronson and Cedric Alexander join a violent restructuring.
chapters.context: JDC’s introduction of his replacement becomes an ambush. Edwards and the new lineup attack both veterans and expel Moose.

chapters.title: Moose wins No Surrender
chapters.result: Moose defeats Eddie Edwards with JDC in his corner.
chapters.context: The former stablemates fight under a corner-towel stipulation. Moose’s victory delivers revenge for the faction’s betrayal.
